scenes.title: I'm an Agent
scenes.summary: Paquita Salas introduces her talent agency PS Management while her assistant Magüi praises her, until Paquita checks whether star client Macarena García has called.

scenes.title: Cocktail or Long Dress?
scenes.summary: Magüi explains she has worked with Paquita since childhood in Getafe, actress Lidia San José recalls her early television hits, and Paquita sends Lidia to tonight's Cosmopolitan party in Maca's place.

scenes.title: People Who Want to Work
scenes.summary: Lidia lists her recent credits from a film in China to thirty quiz-show appearances, while Paquita insists actors must seize every job and recalls a client who turned down Puente Viejo.

scenes.title: Opening theme song
scenes.summary: Opening title sequence song following Paquita through the streets of Madrid.

scenes.title: Red Is Your Colour
scenes.summary: Getting ready for the country wedding of Paquita's ex-husband Paco, Paquita coaxes a shy Magüi out in a red dress and jokes about sending a photo to Magüi's ex.

scenes.title: If I Drink, Everyone Drinks
scenes.summary: Paquita boasts about her marriage to film producer Paco Cerdeña and pours shots to loosen Magüi up before the wedding, insisting teetotaller Lidia toast with them too.

scenes.title: It's Voicemail
scenes.summary: Paquita answers a call from young actor David instead of Maca, leaves a worried message on Maca's voicemail about her premiere dress, and praises Maca's starring role in Vicenta.

scenes.title: Can You Check That Plug?
scenes.summary: Courier Álex delivers a parcel, asks to send his actress cousin's showreel, takes Paquita's card, compliments Magüi, and stays five minutes to inspect a loose wall socket.

scenes.title: There's a Change of Plan
scenes.summary: Paquita calls Juanfran on Maca's television set and learns shooting was pushed back to half past eight, meaning Maca will miss her train to Seminci because an email warning never arrived.

scenes.title: There's No Airport in Valladolid
scenes.summary: With trains to Valladolid sold out and the night train taking eight hours, Paquita demands flights while Magüi insists Valladolid has no airport.

scenes.title: Married to This Job
scenes.summary: Álex checks the agency's spam folder and uncovers 143 unread emails including Juanfran's urgent schedule notices; Paquita forgives Magüi and skips Paco's wedding to drive Maca to Valladolid herself.

scenes.title: Five Days Ago
scenes.summary: Sorting through the spam folder with Álex after Paquita leaves, Magüi discovers an email sent five days earlier in which Macarena left Paquita's agency, and leaves Paquita an urgent voicemail.

scenes.title: Did You Get My Email?
scenes.summary: Still wearing her wedding suit, Paquita surprises Maca outside her TV studio with the blue premiere dress ready in the car; when Maca asks if Paquita got her email, an oblivious Paquita blames technology.

scenes.title: In the Car
scenes.summary: Driving toward Valladolid, Paquita startles Maca by mentioning the two shots she drank earlier, puts on pop-rock music, and laughs with Maca about zipping up her dress onstage at the Goya Awards.

scenes.title: The Perfect Dress
scenes.summary: At a highway gas station, a tearful Maca speaks about searching for the right dress; Paquita misses the metaphor until she answers Magüi's call in the restroom and learns Maca left her five days ago.

scenes.title: Always Gorgeous
scenes.summary: At the Seminci red carpet in Valladolid, Paquita entrusts Maca to coordinator Sofi, claims she is heading back to Madrid, and calls out that Maca will always look gorgeous whatever dress she wears.

scenes.title: Closing credits song
scenes.summary: Closing song over Paquita driving back alone through the night.
